mapper.sql: SELECT ESNTL_ID AS uniqId , 'USR01' AS userTy , MBER_ID AS userId , MBER_NM AS userNm , MBER_EMAIL_ADRES AS emailAdres , GROUP_ID AS groupId , MBER_STTUS AS sttus , SBSCRB_DE AS sbscrbDe FROM TB_GNRL_MBER UNION ALL SELECT ESNTL_ID AS uniqId , 'USR02' AS userTy , ENTRPRS_MBER_ID AS userId , CMPNY_NM AS userNm , APPLCNT_EMAIL_ADRES AS emailAdres , GROUP_ID AS groupId , ENTRPRS_MBER_STTUS AS sttus , SBSCRB_DE AS sbscrbDe FROM TB_ENTRPRS_MBER UNION ALL SELECT ESNTL_ID AS uniqId , 'USR03' AS userTy , EMPLYR_ID AS userId , USER_NM AS userNm , EMAIL_ADRES AS emailAdres , GROUP_ID AS groupId , EMPLYR_STTUS_CODE AS sttus , SBSCRB_DE AS sbscrbDe FROM TB_EMPLYR_INFO
mapper.select: SELECT ESNTL_ID AS uniqId , 'USR01' AS userTy , MBER_ID AS mberId , MBER_NM AS mberNm , PASSWORD AS password , PASSWORD_HINT AS passwordHint , PASSWORD_CNSR AS passwordCnsr , IHIDNUM AS ihidnum , SEXDSTN_CODE AS sexdstnCode , ZIP AS zip , ADRES AS adres , AREA_NO AS areaNo , MBER_STTUS AS mberSttus , DETAIL_ADRES AS detailAdres , END_TELNO AS endTelno , MBTLNUM AS moblphonNo , GROUP_ID AS groupId , MBER_FXNUM AS mberFxnum , MBER_EMAIL_ADRES AS mberEmailAdres , MIDDLE_TELNO AS middleTelno , TELNO AS telno , OCCP_TY AS occpTy , TO_CHAR(SBSCRB_DE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sbscrbDe FROM TB_GNRL_MBER WHERE ESNTL_ID = #{uniqId}

SELECT ESNTL_ID AS uniqId , 'USR03' AS userTy , EMPLYR_ID AS mberId , USER_NM AS mberNm , PASSWORD_HINT AS passwordHint , PASSWORD_CNSR AS passwordCnsr , IHIDNUM AS ihidnum , SEXDSTN_CODE AS sexdstnCode , ZIP AS zip , HOUSE_ADRES AS adres , AREA_NO AS areaNo , EMPLYR_STTUS_CODE AS mberSttus , DETAIL_ADRES AS detailAdres , HOUSE_END_TELNO AS endTelno , MBTLNUM AS moblphonNo , GROUP_ID AS groupId , FXNUM AS mberFxnum , EMAIL_ADRES AS mberEmailAdres , HOUSE_MIDDLE_TELNO AS middleTelno , OFFM_TELNO AS telno , OCCP_TY AS occpTy , TO_CHAR(SBSCRB_DE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sbscrbDe FROM TB_EMPLYR_INFO WHERE ESNTL_ID = #{uniqId}
SELECT USE_STPLAT_ID , USE_STPLAT_CN , INFO_PROVD_AGRE_CN FROM TB_STPLAT_INFO WHERE USE_STPLAT_ID = #{stplatId}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS usedCnt FROM ( SELECT EMPLYR_ID AS userId FROM TB_EMPLYR_INFO UNION ALL SELECT ENTRPRS_MBER_ID AS userId FROM TB_ENTRPRS_MBER UNION ALL SELECT MBER_ID AS userId FROM TB_GNRL_MBER ) A WHERE userId = #{checkId}
